name: Manx Telecom Douglas North Datacentre
notes: One of Manx Telecom's twin Tier 3-standard datacentres on Greenfield Road, Douglas North: 8,232 sq ft, 280 racks, 3 data halls per official Isle of Man Datacentre site; purpose-built (GBP 10m, 2013) and historically hosting PokerStars/Full Tilt/PaddyPower per local press.

name: Manx Telecom Greenhill Datacentre
notes: Second of Manx Telecom's twin Tier 3-designed datacentres: 7,599 sq ft, 211 racks, 2 data halls per official site; IOM Today confirms twin Douglas North + Greenhill facilities.

name: Continent 8 Isle of Man Data Centre
notes: Purpose-built Tier-3 Isle of Man data centre at Continent 8 House, Pulrose Road, Douglas IM2 1AL; official location page confirms DC/hosting and regulated cloud services; opened 2008 with initial GBP 5m investment per company materials; serves e-gaming/regulated sectors.

name: The Isle of Man Datacentre (Domicilium)
notes: The Isle of Man Datacentre, Ronaldsway Industrial Estate, Ballasalla IM9 2RS (official contact page + Digital Isle of Man directory); 'smart shelter' design with capacity for up to 750 cabinets at full build-out; earlier Data Center Knowledge described a 22,000 sq ft centre.

name: The Dataport (Netcetera)
notes: Netcetera owns/operates The Dataport, Ballasalla/Malew IM9 2AP, Tier 3/4, built 2006, ~16,000 sq ft, 10MW per directories; official page confirms datacentre operation; confidence C because Manx Technology Group's Feb 2026 market note states Netcetera exited the datacentre market in late 2025 - current operation/ownership unverified.

name: Sure Isle of Man Data Centre Services
developer: Sure by Beyon (Sure Isle of Man)
notes: Sure official page confirms secure colocation/hosting across Jersey, Guernsey and the Isle of Man (Crown Dependencies data centres, ISO 27001/22301, PCI-DSS); specific Isle of Man facility address not published - A-grade service evidence, facility address confidence low/unknown; 2026 terms PDF exists for IOM data-centre services.

name: Wi-Manx Heywood House Data Centre (Noventre)
notes: Historical Douglas data centre at Heywood House (DataCenterMap listing; DCD 2016 coverage of Wi-Manx colocation/cloud); Wi-Manx rebranded to Noventre (2025), current official pages emphasize managed IT/connectivity with no current facility page - current operational status unknown; historical/directory lead only.
